referenceRole: Screenshot of the repository's PhysicalButton, round/hazard/default red materials, blank cap, front indicator illuminated for the reference capture.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent mascot/brand object for the unlikely ui React component library.
Input image 1 is a reference screenshot of our OWN PhysicalButton component, not a character illustration. Re-create that same physical button as a polished 3D product-style brand asset.
Keep its identifying geometry and colors: a completely circular low cylindrical near-black/olive casing, a circular inset top plate with broad diagonal yellow and charcoal hazard stripes, a dark concentric bezel, a large gently domed smooth coral-red push cap with a rounded upper edge, and one small horizontal mint-green indicator light centered on the FRONT wall.
Match the screenshot's near-front overhead view, with the left and right sides level. The cap should be clearly raised above the bezel, with believable rounded thickness. Keep the body pleasantly compact and hefty like the actual component. Soft satin plastic, precise bevels, restrained studio highlights, subtle material detail. Make it feel like a real well-crafted version of the UI component, not a flat cartoon icon.
Composition: exactly one button, centered, fully visible, occupying approximately 80% of the square canvas with an even transparent margin. Camera aimed straight at the front, looking down roughly 35 degrees, no sideways rotation or roll. Grounded contact shadow only, no floor plane or scenery. The indicator glows gently and is integrated into the front casing.
Background: genuinely transparent with alpha, clean edges suitable for both warm cream and dark olive UI backgrounds.
No text, no letters, no wordmark, no icons stamped on the cap, no face, no eyes, no mouth, no hands, no limbs, no extra objects. Preserve the round base; never a square base. Avoid toy character features, exaggerated perspective, floating parts, busy textures, or neon lighting.
status: Preserved perspective variant; front-facing.json records the head-on revision, and wider-base.json records the current logo.
